title: Sgt. Weaver at the scheduling boards
description: Sgt. Weaver — an ex-Marine, Larry says — leans on the quarter-hour flight-scheduling racks inside the pegboard-walled operations van, cigarette in hand, whistle cord around his neck. The boards behind him carry stenciled time blocks and a ruled status chart; a shield-shaped pocket patch on his fatigues appears to end '...CONTROL'.
researchNotes: Larry's own identification (Memories comment, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0014-c18032226.json). The survey had independently read this man's name tape as beginning 'WE...' — testimony and the machine reading converge on WEAVER. Weaver is also the sergeant (an E5) who responded to the bathroom shooting in Larry's fuller 2026-08-15 account (data/recollections/giscus-stories-c18035411.json). The '...CONTROL' pocket patch fits Larry's statement that the van crew were flight controllers (VN-0011). Magnification pass 2026-08-15 (research/magnification/vn-0014-pocket-patch.png): the patch shows a bird-form center over two lines of red lettering, but the letters sit below this scan's resolution — the full reading now waits on a high-resolution re-scan of the original slide.
